_comment: Median timings (milliseconds). Captured 2026-11-01 on the dev host (Intel Core Ultra 7 258V, 8 threads, CPython 3.14) under a full pytest run, then padded ~1.5x for host noise. The regression test fails at 2.5x these values, so it trips at roughly 3.75x today's real cost. Re-baseline deliberately when hardware changes; CI skips this guard (BELOTE_SKIP_PERF=1).
_history: drive_round_ms: 4.21 (4.6.1, pre-RoundLedger) → 3.67 (4.6.2, post-RoundLedger restructure; per-event dataclasses.replace eliminated, joker handler registry added). 4.9.2: re-baselined render/legal_cards for pytest-runtime noise. 4.11.0: the old baselines were 8-10x the current host's medians (new hardware), so the guard could not catch a regression; re-captured. Measured medians: render 0.091, legal_cards cold 0.0018 / warm 0.0013, score_round 0.024, trick_card_points 0.0008, drive_round 1.06 (scripts/benchmark.py). 4.11.0 also cached Card.__hash__ (classic rounds -21% wall time in scripts/hotspots.py).
